text: Financial markets are notoriously prone to mistaking a fundamental institutional shift for a temporary liquidity crisis. The futurist Roy Amara is often credited with the observation that people tend to overestimate the short-term effect of a transformation while underestimating its long-term impact. text_zh: 金融市场极易将根本性的制度转变误判为暂时的流动性危机，这一点众所周知。未来学家罗伊·阿马拉常被认为提出了这一观察：人们往往高估一场变革的短期影响，而低估其长期影响。中国的房地产行业正提供一个教科书式的案例。
